name: head-nobailout
dirtyNote: Same commit as react-builds/head, with only enableSameElementBailout set to false (experimental). Built in a detached worktree with: yarn build -r=experimental --type=NODE_DEV,NODE_PROD react/index react/jsx react-dom/index react-dom/client scheduler use-sync-external-store. Versus head, only react-dom-client.* differs; react, react-dom and scheduler production bundles are byte-identical.

copiedFromHead.reason: The partial build skipped react/compiler-runtime, which compiled bundles import. packages/react never references enableSameElementBailout, and react.production.js is byte-identical between head and head-nobailout, so these are the same bytes a rebuild would produce.

notBuilt: Server, react-server, profiling, test-utils and unstable_testing bundles aren't in this build. The benchmarks don't load them.
